# LiteORM documentation

Canonical technical documentation is maintained in the LiteORM source repository.
Pages are static, versioned, and intended for people and AI agents.

- [LiteORM Documentation](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/index)
- [LiteORM Core GA Contract](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/reference/core-contract)
- [Extension Contracts](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/reference/extensions)
- [MyBatis Compatibility](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/reference/mybatis-compatibility)
- [Architecture](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/architecture)
- [Choosing an Extension](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/core/extensions)
- [Choosing a Value or Row Mapping](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/core/mapping)
- [Core Guides](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/core/README)
- [Standalone JDBC](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/core/standalone)
- [Quick Start](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/getting-started)
- [Migrating From MyBatis](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/migration/from-mybatis)
- [Migration Guides](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/migration/README)
- [Using The Migration Skill](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/migration/using-migration-skill)
- [LiteORM User Documentation](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/README)
- [Spring Guides](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/spring/README)
- [Spring Boot Integration](https://lite-orm.github.io/docs/user/spring/spring-boot)
